environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with a Function URL configured with AuthType=NONE. The function URL is publicly accessible at https://abc123.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/. No CloudFront distribution or API Gateway in front. The function URL accepts requests from any origin with cookies attached by the browser (SameSite=None on session cookies set by the companion frontend at app.example.com). No CORS restrictions configured on the function URL (default allows all origins).
